name: apidoc
desc: Fetch a JSON endpoint, infer the response shape, and emit markdown documentation with types, nesting, nullability and example values

name: apiprobe
desc: Fingerprint a JSON API: allowed methods, content types, pagination style, auth scheme, rate headers

name: bingindex
desc: Probe whether a URL or site: operator appears indexed on several engines using their public HTML endpoints, and report which returned results with a snippet

name: cacheheader
desc: Check Cache-Control, Expires, ETag, Last-Modified and Vary on each URL and flag conflicts, missing validators and no-store on static assets

name: canoncheck
desc: Audit rel=canonical across a page set: missing or non-self canonicals, cross-domain targets, canonical chains and duplicate clusters

name: changelog
desc: Summarize releases from the GitHub Releases API, a CHANGELOG.md or a releases HTML page

name: codeblock
desc: Pull every <pre><code> (and standalone <pre>) block out of a page, detect the language from class names, and print them as markdown fences

name: contractcheck
desc: Validate a live or on-disk JSON document against a JSON Schema and report every violation with its exact JSON path and the rule that failed

name: cookiejar
desc: Turn Set-Cookie headers (or a live fetch) into a cookie jar with flag explanations and Netscape export

name: corsmatrix
desc: Probe CORS behaviour for a list of origins against a list of endpoints, record the allow-origin/credentials/vary response per cell, and flag the dangerous combinations

name: csspeek
desc: Score every CSS rule for specificity and complexity, flag duplicate declaration blocks and selectors no class/id on the page uses, and inventory @media/@supports blocks

name: dnsforurl
desc: Resolve a URL host over DNS (A/AAAA/CNAME/NS/MX/TXT) and infer the CDN or hosting provider

name: domquery
desc: Query HTML with tag/class/id/attribute selectors plus descendant, child and sibling combinators, printing each match with its text and attributes

name: embedparse
desc: Turn a media URL (YouTube/Vimeo/Twitter/Spotify/...) into provider, id and ready-to-paste embed HTML

name: feeddiff
desc: Compare two RSS/Atom/JSON feed snapshots by item identity and list new, removed and edited entries with the exact fields that changed

name: feedmerge
desc: Merge many RSS/Atom/JSON feeds into one deduplicated timeline sorted by date

name: formfiller
desc: Read every <form> on a page, synthesise plausible values per input type, and print the ready-to-send request (curl, body, multipart)

name: harfetch
desc: Replay every request in a HAR capture and compare status, size and wall time against the recording

name: hreflang
desc: Audit hreflang, canonical and alternate link tags for consistency, reciprocity and validity

name: hreflanggraph
desc: Collect alternate hreflang annotations across a page set, group them into language clusters and flag missing return links, bad codes and self-reference errors

name: htmltable
desc: Find every <table> on a page and emit its rows as JSON or CSV with proper rowspan/colspan handling

name: htmlvalid
desc: Lint HTML for unclosed tags, duplicate ids, missing alt, inline handlers and other inline-fixable defects

name: httpmirror
desc: Crawl a URL list into a single JSON archive holding request and response records (status, headers, base64 body) plus an offline replay command

name: httpstatus
desc: Look up any HTTP status code (1xx-5xx plus unofficial ones) with meaning, cause and fix hints

name: jsonfeed
desc: Detect the feed format, normalise every entry into one schema, and emit it as JSON with per-format field coverage notes

name: jsonld
desc: Pull every JSON-LD block off a page, validate its shape and summarise the schema.org graph

name: jsonquery
desc: Fetch (or read) JSON and run a jq-like path query with slicing, mapping and filtering

name: keyworddensity
desc: Count 1-, 2- and 3-grams in the readable text with stopwords removed, weight terms found in headings, and score them by TF-IDF against a second reference page

name: linkcheck
desc: Extract every link on a page and report HTTP status, redirect target and dead links

name: markdownify
desc: Hand-written HTML to markdown converter covering headings, emphasis, links, images, lists, tables, code fences, blockquotes and horizontal rules

name: metaform
desc: Inventory every <form> on a page with its fields, hidden inputs, CSRF token and submit-target hints

name: metalink
desc: Pull OpenGraph, Twitter-card, canonical and oEmbed metadata off any page into one object

name: microdata
desc: Parse itemscope/itemprop microdata and RDFa vocab/property/typeof attributes into a nested item tree keyed by schema.org type

name: mimeprint
desc: Map file extensions to MIME types (and back) with the correct Content-Type header to send

name: mockjson
desc: Learn the shape of a sample JSON payload and emit a seeded generator script plus ready-generated mock records with realistic value substitution per field name

name: musicsearch
desc: Query the iTunes Search API and MusicBrainz for tracks, artists and albums; rate-limited and cached

name: opengraph
desc: Check every og: and twitter: tag against what each platform needs, then render the text preview card that would be shown when the link is shared

name: pagerankish
desc: Crawl a handful of same-host pages, build the internal link graph, and rank every page by in-degree plus a damped PageRank iteration

name: pagestruct
desc: Print the h1-h6 outline with level skips flagged, count multiple h1s, and report missing or repeated nav/main/aside/footer landmarks

name: pageweight
desc: Inventory every subresource a page loads, grouped by type, with sizes when the server reports them

name: paginate
desc: Walk page/cursor/offset/link-header pagination on a JSON API and collect all records

name: ratelim
desc: Read an API's rate-limit headers and compute a safe request pacing / concurrency plan

name: readtime
desc: Estimate reading and speaking time, a Flesch-style difficulty score, and how much of the page is prose versus code, tables and lists

name: redirectchain
desc: Walk a redirect chain hop by hop and report status, Location, timing and the loop/limit verdict

name: robbots
desc: Fetch and parse robots.txt, then evaluate paths against any user-agent with full precedence rules

name: robotsdiff
desc: Compare two robots.txt files rule by rule per user-agent and state exactly which paths became blocked, unblocked, or changed crawl-delay

name: rssgrab
desc: Fetch RSS, Atom or JSON feeds and normalize every entry to title/link/date/summary

name: schemagen
desc: Merge one or more JSON samples into a draft-07 schema with required-field detection, enum inference for repeating literals and format hints for dates, emails and URLs

name: searchsuggest
desc: Collect autocomplete suggestions from DuckDuckGo, Wikipedia, Google and Brave for keyword research

name: searchurl
desc: Compose properly percent-encoded search URLs for Google, Bing, DuckDuckGo, Startpage, Brave and Yandex from operator combinations, with a shell-safe copy line

name: seohead
desc: Audit title/description/canonical/robots/OG/structured-data in one report with length and duplicate checks

name: sitemapdiff
desc: Compare two sitemaps and report URLs added, removed, lastmod-changed, priority-changed, plus which new URLs look like they should be polled for indexing first

name: sitemapgen
desc: Breadth-first crawl of one origin and emit a valid sitemap.xml (or JSON url list)

name: sitemapvalidate
desc: Check URL and sitemap-index files for spec violations: bad lastmod format, out-of-range priority or changefreq values, non-absolute locs, size and count limits, and gzip handling

name: sitestatus
desc: Query Statuspage / Instatus / Google Cloud status APIs and summarise which services are degraded

name: tabletext
desc: Turn any HTML table into a monospaced grid with computed column widths, honouring rowspan and colspan and wrapping cells that are too wide

name: textgrab
desc: Strip scripts, nav and markup from an HTML page and return the readable article text

name: uacheck
desc: Decode one or many User-Agent strings into browser, version, engine, OS, device class and bot flags
usage: node tools/uacheck.js "Mozilla/5.0 (iPhone; CPU iPhone OS 17_0 like Mac OS X) AppleWebKit/605.1.15 (KHTML, like Gecko) Version/17.0 Mobile/15E148 Safari/604.1" --json

name: urlx
desc: Parse, normalize, de-track, resolve and diff URLs with a query-string builder

name: warcbuild
desc: Crawl URLs and write a hand-assembled WARC 1.1 file with warcinfo, request and response records using correct CRLF line endings and Content-Length blocks

name: webfont
desc: Inventory every @font-face and font load on a page, classify the loading strategy (local, preload, display swap, self-hosted vs third-party) and estimate FOUT/FOIT risk
